title: The model runtime is not the declared instance identity
claim: CPAS continuity should preserve a stable declared identity and epistemic policy while treating provider, model, tools, and state availability as replaceable runtime bindings.

confidence.basis: The v1 declaration's model changed in repository history without an identity redesign, and current platforms expose replaceable model/tool adapters.

assumptions.statement: An instance identity is a declared interaction architecture rather than ontological persistence.

evidence.summary: The baseline repository audit records the Clarence-9 model-binding history and current implementation boundaries.

uncertainties.statement: Stable declaration digests do not guarantee equivalent behavior across model runtimes.

contested_zones.question: Which policy fields must remain in the stable identity projection across future CPAS versions?
positions: Keep safety policy in the stable projection.
Version safety policy separately to permit governance updates.

invalidation_triggers.condition: A reviewed CPAS release intentionally makes runtime metadata part of stable identity.

evolution.change_summary: Initial v2 modernization anchor derived from the architecture audit.

provenance.created_by: OpenAI Codex modernization draft under Spartan-M34 stewardship
transformations: Structured as a DKA-E v2 epistemic record.

presentation.summary: Preserve the higher-level span while replacing the runtime supports.
